requirements.notes: The source imports numpy and constructs RTDEControlInterface and RTDEReceiveInterface at top level, using a hardcoded demonstration address. Importing the file can connect and immediately move hardware. Inspect and adapt the address, six-joint target, TCP offsets, speed and acceleration for the authorized installation before any execution. The code commands joint motion, reads TCP pose, moves 0.15 m down in Z and then 0.10 m in X, returns to the original TCP pose and joint target, and stops its control script. Source comments do not establish reachability or collision safety. The pinned README provides project-level installation and robot/OS declarations; no package versions, Python version, firmware, OS or robot environment combination was resolved or tested for this example.
